adds.rationale: NuScale Power's stock jumped 13% on a 'historic SMR deployment agreement,' a concrete commercial catalyst that puts it squarely in the buildup phase of the near-term nuclear/SMR wave named in the thesis, reinforced by DOE fuel-supply-chain and rising uranium-demand headlines the same week.

news_evidence.summary: NuScale Power stock surges 13% on historic SMR deployment agreement
DOE seeks U.S. companies for new nuclear fuel supply chain consortium
World Nuclear Association: uranium demand for nuclear power set to surge nearly 30% by 2030

removes.rationale: A notable investor was reported this week selling Microsoft to rotate into a rival AI name up nearly 800% over the decade, a rotation-out-of-MSFT signal that, paired with no fresh MSFT-specific catalyst in the pool, makes it the weakest of the four current AI mega-cap holdings to fund a first step into the nuclear buildup wave.

news_evidence.summary: Billionaire Steve Mandel sold Microsoft stock to buy a dominant AI stock up nearly 800% over the past decade

rationale_overall: Filtered out heavy noise: private/non-investable space stories (SpaceX Starship milestones, satellite science, Gilmour), foreign/OTC and non-US names (SK Telecom/Schneider Ulsan JV, ADE India cruise missile, Vietnam nuclear project), keyword false-matches (Rocket Companies/Mr. Cooper mortgage deal, 'Sprocket Rocket' sports league, Garmin satellite watch, Virgin 'pocket rocket' jets), pure geopolitical/military event coverage with no clean US-listed ticker (Typhon missile deployment, Golden Dome leasing, Taiwan Strait warship incident, Lockheed's $9.8B award — already well-known defense prime, not a fresh thematic entry), and generic AI-adoption human-interest pieces (Philippine startups, Oakland Ballers AI umpiring, Uber AI labelling, MTSU classroom rules). The one genuine, thesis-aligned catalyst was NuScale's historic SMR deployment agreement, a concrete buildup-phase signal for the near-term nuclear wave, funded by trimming Microsoft on a reported billionaire rotation out of the name into a rival AI leader. AAPL, GOOGL, NVDA are kept as the still-intact AI core; SPY remains the anchor.
